chunks: "Give charity early, for calamities do not pass beyond it. Whoever gives charity at the beginning of the day, Allah protects him from the evil of what descends from the sky on that day. And if he gives charity at the beginning of the night, Allah protects him from the evil of what descends from the sky during that night."

key_terms.السَّمَاءِ: the heaven/sky, indicating what comes down by Divine decree
key_terms.اللَّيْلَةِ: the night in which protection is granted
key_terms.بِالصَّدَقَةِ: with charity; voluntary giving in the way of Allah

ai.seo_question: How does giving charity early protect a person from calamities?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of giving charity early in the day or night as a means of protection from afflictions and harmful decrees that may descend. It emphasizes sadaqah as a spiritually effective act that brings Divine safeguarding.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Give charity early in the day, for calamities do not surpass it. Whoever gives charity at the beginning of the day, Allah (swt) will protect him from the evil that descends from the sky that day. And if he gives charity at the beginning of the night, Allah (swt) will protect him from the evil that descends from the sky during that night."
